# cache — Testing

Global policy: [`/TESTING_GUIDELINE.md`](../../../TESTING_GUIDELINE.md).

## Targets

| Layer | Target |
|---|---|
| `domain/` | 90 % |
| `service/` | 80 % |
| `repository/` | every query exercised by an integration test |
| `transport/http/` | every endpoint has a contract test |

## What to test

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: test-focus -->
- Every consumer's fallback path with Redis stopped
- Single-flight collapses concurrent loads into one
- TTL jitter is applied
- Lock release is token-checked
- Rate limiter boundaries: exactly at the limit, and just over
- Version bump invalidates a whole class
<!-- END GENERATED: test-focus -->

## Running

```bash
go test ./internal/platform/cache/...
go test -tags=integration ./internal/platform/cache/...
go test -run TestXxx -race -v ./internal/platform/cache/...
```

## AI-assisted test generation

Use `docs/prompts/dev/testing/generate-unit-test.md`. Give the agent this module's
`AGENT.md` §9 (business rules) as the oracle — **never the implementation**, or the test will
inherit the implementation's bugs.
